bundle_product_definition.defaultMessage:
Bundle

As the name suggest this product type enables you to create a collection/bundle of products as one and set the price accordingly. This type of product is useful if you have christmas package for example.

configurable_product_definition.defaultMessage:
Configurable

Configurable Product is used to organize varieties of a product. A product might have a variation in color, size or other distinct property in that case you can use a configurable product type to organize all the variation under one category and outline there difference.
